rows.information: ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-NBSS&LUP
content_sections.text: ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning is located on Amravati Road, Nagpur, and its letterhead marks 50 years of serving the nation. This post falls under the "Mission for Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti)" program titled "Development of AI-aided early warning and real-time monitoring systems and UAV-aided precision pest management strategies".

content_sections.heading: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Young Professional-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 21 to 45 years, with relaxation as per the rule. Post graduate/graduate in any one of the following: Computer Science and engineering Computer Applications Geoinformatics Remote Sensing & GIS Soil Science Agricultural Physics Data Science & Computing Artificial Intelligence Geology Geography One year of working experience in Machine Learning/Big Data Analytics and Remote Sensing Working knowledge in spatial database handling, management and analysis in GIS These two points are desirable, not essential. For the discipline-specific eligibility of this post, see the official notification (PDF) .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The post is filled through a walk-in interview at the Nagpur office. The decision of the Director, ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Amravati Road, Nagpur-440 033, will be final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The manpower shall be engaged on a purely contractual basis. The engagement is extendable till the termination of the project, subject to the candidate's satisfactory performance. The post is co-terminus with the project, so the selected candidate shall not claim regular appointment at ICAR-NBSS&LUP.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-NBSS&LUP Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare an application stating the post you are applying for. The notice makes this compulsory. Prepare a CV that mentions your name, Father's/Husband's name, date of birth, whether SC/ST/OBC, academic qualifications, research experience, publications (if any), address for correspondence, contact number and mail id. Reach ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning, Amravati Road, Nagpur-440 033, for the interview at 11:00 AM on the interview date. Bring these with you: Application for the post CV Passport size photograph Attested copies of mark-sheets and certificates Relevant degree certificate

faq.question: Q1. Is one year of experience compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: No. The one year of working experience in Machine Learning/Big Data Analytics and Remote Sensing is listed as desirable, not as an essential qualification.

faq.question: Q2. Can a graduate attend, or is a postgraduate degree needed?
faq.answer: Both can attend. The notice asks for "Post graduate/graduate" in one of the listed subjects, which include Geoinformatics, Agricultural Physics and Artificial Intelligence.

faq.question: Q3. Which project is this post under?
faq.answer: It is under the "Mission for Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti)" program, which covers AI-aided early warning, real-time monitoring and UAV-aided precision pest management.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely contractual and ends with the project, and the selected candidate cannot claim regular appointment.

faq.question: Q5. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the selected candidate work?
faq.answer: The place of work is the RSA Division of NBSS&LUP, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring your application, CV, a passport size photograph, attested copies of mark-sheets and certificates, and the relevant degree certificate.

faq.question: Q8. How can I contact the office?
faq.answer: The letterhead gives the phone numbers 0712-2500545 and 2500664 (Extn. 106, 120) and the email [email protected].
